{{Top}}
[[File:Mech_factory.jpg|thumb|right|A mech factory used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].]]
A '''factory''' was an industrial site containing several buildings and power plants in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They came in a variety of functions, including civilian products and vehicles, as well as developing several military weapons and small-scale [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

Weapons factories included the [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|Geonosis droid foundries]], the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|Geonosis primary droid foundry]], the [[CIS Weapons Factory]], the [[Hypori droid factory]], [[Ice Station Beta/Legends|Imperial Robotics Construction Facility Ice Station Beta]], the [[Incom Factory]], the [[Olanet droid factory]], as well as the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]].
